versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the wcs-add-frontend-page skill.
- Provides step-by-step instructions for adding new frontend business pages to WCS Vue2 applications, focusing on strict reuse of existing page patterns.
- Outlines checks to confirm API usage, data dictionary keys, and to avoid duplicating or conflicting files/routes/i18n keys.
- Details best practices for creating API modules, Vue page components, route entries, and i18n configurations—stressing adherence to project conventions.
